content_zh:
刚才本来自己想直劈下去的，可是想到按照自己的那种力量，若是当真的就这么直劈了下去，那这悟凯可能会被直接变成俩半，而不是被打断双手这么简单了。
但为了一些不必要的麻烦，刘枫并没有要他的命，只不过是把要赖于生存的东西夺了去。
或许在某种情况之下，这比死会让他更难受。
从此以后，变成一个用不了双手的格斗家，这本来就不得不说是一种极大的痛苦。
这种比试没有丝毫的怜悯，刘枫非常的明白，若悟凯有那个机会的吧，肯定会毫不客气的将自己废掉。
所以，他的内中也没有任何的不安。
眼神冷漠的看着在地上不断打滚嚎叫的悟凯，转过头，对一旁已经呆立的狂想佣兵团的其余人，笑道：“怎么？你们不打算去帮一下他吗？”
被刘枫冰冷的眼光一瞟，一群人不自住的打了一个寒战。
最前面的一人，哆嗦着道：“小子。。。我。我们团长会找。你们算帐的。。”
刘枫闻言眉头一挑，手中巨剑慢慢倾斜。
那人一见到这动作，骇得连退了好几步，被身后的同伴拉住。
**********
看着极其狼狈逃窜的狂想佣兵的团员，刘枫不屑的笑了笑。
“嘿，小枫，你真猛啊。”矮人巴达斯的大嗓门最先响起。
满脸笑容的矮人，跑到刘枫身边，跳了跳，似乎很想拍一下这位英雄的肩膀，不过接连跳了几下，都没达成目的，只要郁闷的捎了捎脑袋。
“呵呵，小枫，没事吧？”肯斯也笑着走了上来，关切的问道。
满脸的笑容显示出他此时内心的愉悦。
魔法师贝法也是一脸的潮红，激动无比。
精灵莫非倒好，只是朝刘枫竖起了大拇指。
“呵呵，还不错，我们也走吧。”刘枫笑了笑，看着周围围满了的人群，说道。

“好。”目的已经达到，众人也非常的满意了。
**********
后面的几天，非常的平静，狂想佣兵团不知道什么原因，也并没有前来报复。
一切都似乎同往常没有俩样。
刘枫现在陪着肯斯他们出了好几趟的任务，对佣兵的生活也慢慢的越加有兴趣了起来。
“嘿，小枫，今天我们接到一个C阶任务哟，很不错，若不是我机灵，就轮不到我们了。”矮人在还没到门口的时候，就老远的大叫了起来。
“哦？C阶吗？是挺不错的。”刘枫也是一愣，没想到竟然能够遇到C阶的任务。
这C阶任务在佣兵会差不多是一个月有一个吧，反正是粥多僧少，想不到巴达斯竟然能够抢上一个。
听到矮人的大声吆喝，在空地上练习箭法的莫非也回过了头，满意的点了点头：“没想到，你还真是有点用处了。”
本来兴高采烈的矮人闻言，顿时暴跳如雷：“莫非，我跟你说了多少次了？你不就是射箭射得准一些吗？有什么了不起？你有种把我这大锤轮起来耍耍？”
看着喋喋不休的矮人，刘枫极其郁闷的翻了翻白眼：“巴达斯，团长说过，你若是在吵，以后就别喝酒了。”
叫骂声噶然而止。
矮人郁闷的捎了捎脑袋，嘟嚷道：“不说就不说嘛，用得着克扣我的酒嘛。”将手中的羊皮纸递了过去：“喏，小枫，就是这个C阶任务，你看看，很不错呢。”
刘枫自动的将他前面的话语省略，接过羊皮纸，仔细的看了起来。
C阶任务，护送佛地兰商队，安全抵达和平小镇，报酬：一万枚金币。
看完内容的刘枫，低头沉思了起来，有点不对啊。。。
从日不落到达和平小镇只不过一天的路程，途中只需要穿过短短的一截大草原的地盘，所以也并没有多大的危险，这完全可以当作一D阶甚至E阶的任务发布啊，怎么可能会调成C阶？而且这酬金似乎有些偏高啊？
“这似乎有点问题啊？”刘枫沉吟道。
“哦？什么问题？”莫非收起弓箭，走了过来，听见刘枫的话，好奇的问道。
“喏，你看，这原本最多只是D阶的任务，可是却被调成了C阶，而且报酬很高。”刘枫又将羊皮纸递给了莫非。

“恩，这样看起来，倒还真是有点问题啊，我看，我们还是等团长和贝法回来，一起商量下吧。”莫非看了片刻，出声道。
“恩，那就这样吧。”刘枫轻轻一点头，随既笑道：“希望，没什么大事吧，不然就可惜巴达斯的一片好心了，哈哈。”

content_en:
Just now, I wanted to chop him down, but I thought that with his strength, if he really did it, Wukai might be cut into two halves instead of having his hands broken.
But for some unnecessary trouble, Liu Feng did not kill him, he just took away the things he depended on for survival.
Perhaps under certain circumstances, this would be more painful for him than death.
From now on, becoming a fighter who cannot use his hands has to be said to be a great pain.
There was no mercy at all in this kind of competition. Liu Feng knew very well that if Wu Kai had the chance, he would definitely destroy him without mercy.
Therefore, he did not feel any uneasiness in his heart.
Looking at Wu Kai who was rolling and howling on the ground with cold eyes, he turned his head and smiled at the rest of the Rhapsody mercenary group who were standing aside, "What? Aren't you going to help him?"
Glancing at Liu Feng's cold eyes, a group of people couldn't help but shiver.
The person at the front trembled and said: "Boy... I. Our leader will look for you. You will settle the score..."
Liu Feng raised his eyebrows when he heard this, and slowly tilted the giant sword in his hand.
When the man saw this action, he was so horrified that he took several steps back and was grabbed by his companions behind him.
**********
Liu Feng smiled disdainfully as he looked at the members of the Kuangxiang mercenary group who were running away in great embarrassment.
"Hey, Xiaofeng, you are so fierce." The loud voice of the dwarf Badas was the first to speak.
The dwarf with a smile on his face ran to Liu Feng and jumped, as if he wanted to pat the hero on the shoulder. However, he jumped several times in succession and failed to achieve his goal. He just shook his head in frustration.
"Haha, Xiaofeng, are you okay?" Kensi also walked up with a smile and asked with concern.
The smile on his face showed the joy in his heart at this time.
The magician Befa also had a flushed face and was extremely excited.
The elf was doing well and just gave Liu Feng a thumbs up.
"Haha, not bad, let's go too." Liu Feng smiled, looked at the crowd surrounding him, and said.
"Okay." The goal has been achieved, and everyone is very satisfied.
**********
The next few days were very peaceful. The Rhapsody Mercenary Group did not know the reason and did not come to retaliate.
Everything seemed to be the same as usual.
Liu Feng has now accompanied Kensi and the others on several missions, and he has slowly become more and more interested in the life of a mercenary.
"Hey, Xiaofeng, we received a C-level mission today. It's pretty good. If I hadn't been clever, we wouldn't have had our turn." The dwarf shouted from a distance before he even reached the door.
"Oh? C-level? It's pretty good." Liu Feng was also stunned. He didn't expect to encounter a C-level mission.
There is probably one C-level mission every month in the mercenary association. Anyway, there are too many monks but too many monks. I didn’t expect Badas to be able to grab one.
Hearing the dwarf's loud shouting, Mo Fei, who was practicing archery in the open space, also turned his head and nodded with satisfaction: "I didn't expect that you are really useful."
The originally cheerful dwarf suddenly became furious when he heard this: "Could it be that, how many times have I told you? Aren't you just more accurate in shooting arrows? What's so great about it? You have the guts to play around with my sledgehammer?"
Looking at the chattering dwarf, Liu Feng rolled his eyes extremely depressed: "Badas, the leader said, if you are making a noise, don't drink anymore."
The yelling and cursing stopped.
The dwarf shook his head in frustration and muttered: "If you don't tell me, don't tell me. There's no need to deduct my wine." He handed over the parchment in his hand: "Here, Xiaofeng, this is the C-level mission. Take a look, it's very good."
Liu Feng automatically omitted his previous words, took the parchment, and read it carefully.C-level mission: Escort the Fotilan caravan to reach the peaceful town safely. Reward: 10,000 gold coins.
After reading the content, Liu Feng lowered his head and pondered, something was wrong. . .
It's only a day's journey from Sun Never Set to Heping Town, and you only need to cross a short stretch of prairie territory on the way, so there's not much danger. This can be completely regarded as a D-level or even E-level mission. How could it be adjusted to C-level? And the remuneration seems a bit high?
"There seems to be something wrong with this?" Liu Feng pondered.
"Oh? What's the problem?" Mo Fei put away his bow and arrows and walked over. Hearing Liu Feng's words, he asked curiously.
"Here, look, this was originally a D-level mission at most, but it has been upgraded to C-level, and the pay is very high." Liu Feng handed the parchment to Mo Fei again.
"Well, it looks like there is something wrong. I think we should wait for the leader and Beifa to come back and discuss it together." Mo Fei looked at it for a moment and said.
"Well, let's do that." Liu Feng nodded lightly, then smiled and said: "I hope it's nothing serious, otherwise it will be a pity for Badas's good intentions, haha."
